question:
Identify the meaning of the idiom in the given situation.

I will always __*stand by my friend*__.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"stand by"** means to support or remain loyal to someone, especially in difficult situations. (संकट के समय समर्थन करना)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite all the challenges, she decided to **stand by** her friend through thick and thin.
 
 
 
• **"Support in difficult situation" **refers to being there for someone when they are going through tough times, offering help and encouragement. (कठिन समय में समर्थन करना)
 
 
• **Example: **When he lost his job, his family and friends stood by him, offering both **emotional and financial support.**
 
 

Therefore, the correct idiom for the given statement is to** 'Support in difficult situation.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Be in a queue** (कतार में होना): To stand in a line waiting for something.

 
 
• **Example:** People **were standing in a queue** to buy tickets for the movie.
 
 
 
• **Stand next to** (बगल में खड़ा होना): To be physically positioned beside someone.
 
 
• **Example: **He **stood next to** his friend during the entire ceremony.
 
 
 
• **Work together** (मिलकर काम करना): To collaborate or cooperate with someone on a task or project.
 
 
• **Example:** They decided to** work together** to complete the project on time.
 
 

3e:Tbbb,

The correct answer is **Option 3)**
